findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?utm_source=mcpregistry&utm_campaign=d11-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_call, show, ui, send_data, helper_show, notify_me · Private data: show, send_data, helper_credential, helper_show, helper_decide, helper_next · Public sink: next, show, send_data, notify_me · Destructive: join, say, decide, helper_decide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_call, show, ui, send_data, helper_show, notify_me · Private data: show, send_data, helper_credential, helper_show, helper_decide, helper_next · Public sink: next, show, send_data, notify_me · Destructive: join, say, decide, helper_decide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
